figures.item: UMA (Unidad de Medida y Actualización) DAILY value in force from 1 February 2026 (INEGI). From 1 January to 31 January 2026 the 2025 UMA still applies. The UMA is the reference unit for tax exemptions, caps and fines; it is NOT the minimum wage (salario mínimo).
figures.quote: Diario 117.31 pesos mexicanos

figures.item: UMA MONTHLY value from 1 February 2026 (INEGI). Used for example by the subsidio para el empleo (a percentage of the monthly UMA). Not the minimum wage.
figures.quote: Mensual 3 566.22 pesos mexicanos

figures.item: UMA ANNUAL value from 1 February 2026 (INEGI). Art. 151 LISR caps personal deductions at the LOWER of five times this annual UMA or 15% of total income; the Guide must not state a computed peso cap unless SAT prints it.
figures.quote: Anual 42 794.64 pesos mexicanos

figures.item: Date from which the 2026 UMA values apply. January 2026 still uses the 2025 UMA.
figures.quote: entrarán en vigor a partir del 1 de febrero de 2026

figures.item: Increase of the UMA for 2026 over 2025, as published by INEGI. Informational only.
figures.quote: la variación de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización (UMA) fue de 3.69 %

figures.item: General minimum wage (salario mínimo general) per DAY from 1 January 2026 (CONASAMI), for all of Mexico except the Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte. It is NOT the UMA: tax caps and exemptions are set in UMA, not in minimum wages.
figures.quote: se incremente de 278.80 a 315.04 pesos diarios

figures.item: Minimum wage per DAY from 1 January 2026 in the Zona Libre de la Frontera Norte (ZLFN) (CONASAMI). Different from the general minimum wage.
figures.quote: se incremente de 419.88 a 440.87 pesos diarios

figures.item: Subsidio para el empleo 2026 (Decree modifying the subsidy decree, DOF 31 Dec 2025): the monthly subsidy is the monthly UMA times this percentage, for February to December 2026. For January 2026 the percentage was 15.59% of the 2025 UMA. Applies only to employees (salaries), credited against the ISR withheld.
figures.quote: multiplicar el valor mensual de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización por 15.02%

figures.item: Subsidio para el empleo: percentage applied ONLY for January 2026, on the monthly UMA of 2025 (because the 2026 UMA starts 1 February). Not the percentage for the rest of 2026.
figures.quote: se aplicará el porcentaje de 15.59% de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización vigente en 2025

figures.item: Monthly subsidio para el empleo amount stated in the decree recitals for 2026 (15.02% of the monthly UMA). Maximum monthly amount per employee, February to December 2026.
figures.quote: a 15.02%, el cual representa un monto de $536.22

figures.item: Subsidio para el empleo 2026: only employees whose MONTHLY income used as the ISR base does not exceed this amount receive the subsidy (a cliff, not a phase-out). Decree in force 1 January 2026.
figures.quote: no excedan de $11,492.66

The rate applies to the WHOLE monthly income, not to the excess (flat rate by band). RESICO personas físicas income ceiling (art. 113-E LISR): income of the prior year must not exceed this amount to enter; exceeding it at any time in the year takes the taxpayer out of RESICO from the following month. Printed in words in art. 113-E ('tres millones quinientos mil pesos'); RMF 2026 prints $3’500,000.00 with an apostrophe separator that the gate cannot read, so the digits are proved on the SAT RESICO filling guide table.

RESICO personas físicas: ISR a persona moral must withhold on payments to a RESICO individual for business, professional or rental activity, on the amount without IVA (art. 113-J LISR). Counts as part of the individual's monthly payment. Remitted by day 17 of the following month.
figures.quote: la tasa del 1.25% sobre el monto de los pagos

figures.item: RESICO personas físicas pay monthly by day 17 of the following month (art. 113-E LISR).
figures.quote: a más tardar el día 17 del mes inmediato posterior

figures.item: RESICO personas físicas annual return: in April of the following year (art. 113-F LISR).
figures.quote: presentar su declaración anual en el mes de abril del año siguiente

figures.item: RESICO personas morales (arts. 206 and 214 LISR): prior-year income must not exceed this amount; RMF 2026 rule says the SAT checks it against the prior annual return and can move the company out of the regime. The RMF prints $35’000,000.00 (apostrophe separator, unreadable to the gate as one number), so write it as MXN 35 million.
figures.quote: no hayan excedido de $35’000,000.00

figures.item: Cap on personal deductions (deducciones personales, art. 151 LISR): the total cannot exceed the LOWER of five times the ANNUAL UMA or 15% of the taxpayer's total income (including exempt income). Some items (e.g. donations, retirement contributions) have their own separate limits.
figures.quote: o del 15% del total de los ingresos del contribuyente

figures.item: Cap on personal deductions (art. 151 LISR): five times the annual UMA (the law prints the multiple in words), or 15% of total income if lower. With the 2026 annual UMA from INEGI; do not state a computed peso figure as official.
figures.quote: cinco veces el valor anual de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización

figures.item: Donations to authorised donees (donatarias autorizadas) are deductible up to 7% of the prior year's taxable income (art. 151 fr. III LISR); separate from the general cap.
figures.quote: no exceda del 7% de los ingresos acumulables

figures.item: Voluntary retirement contributions (art. 151 fr. V LISR): deductible up to 10% of taxable income for the year, with an additional cap of five annual UMA (printed in words).
figures.quote: será de hasta el 10% de los ingresos acumulables

figures.item: Individuals file the annual ISR return in April of the following year (art. 150 LISR).
figures.quote: presentarán en el mes de abril del año siguiente

figures.item: Individuals with ONLY salary (Cap. I) and interest (Cap. VI) income may skip the annual return if the total does not exceed this amount AND real interest does not exceed MXN 100,000 with withholding applied (art. 150 LISR). Both conditions.
figures.quote: cuya suma no exceda de $400,000.00

figures.item: Second condition to skip the annual return (art. 150 LISR): real interest (intereses reales) not over this amount, with withholding applied.
figures.quote: intereses reales no excedan de $100,000.00

figures.item: Individuals with total income (including exempt and final-tax income) above this amount must report ALL income in the annual return, including certain exempt items (art. 150 LISR).
figures.quote: superiores a $500,000.00

figures.item: Actividad empresarial y profesional (general regime): monthly provisional ISR payments by day 17 of the following month (art. 106 LISR). Payments are cumulative (year-to-date) using the Anexo 8 monthly accumulated tarifas.
figures.quote: a más tardar el día 17 del mes inmediato posterior

figures.item: ISR withholding by a persona moral paying professional fees (servicios profesionales) to an individual in the general regime (art. 106 LISR), on the amount without deduction. Different from the RESICO 1.25% withholding.
figures.quote: aplicar la tasa del 10% sobre el monto de los pagos

figures.item: Sale of goods other than real estate by individuals (art. 126 LISR): provisional payment of 20% on the total amount of the operation, withheld by the buyer if a persona moral, unless the exception applies.
figures.quote: aplicar la tasa del 20% sobre el monto total de la operación

figures.item: Art. 126 LISR: no 20% withholding on sales of movable goods other than securities or shares where the operation is below this amount. Amount as printed on the SAT article page (not confirmed as inflation-updated for 2026).
figures.quote: el monto de la operación sea menor a $227,400.00

figures.item: Annual ISR withholding rate on interest paid by the financial system (arts. 54 and 135 LISR) for 2026, set by the Ley de Ingresos de la Federación 2026 art. 24. Applied to capital, not to the interest amount.
figures.quote: será del 0.90 por ciento

figures.item: Corporate income tax (ISR personas morales, general regime) rate on the fiscal result (art. 9 LISR).
figures.quote: la tasa del 30%

figures.item: Additional ISR of 10% on dividends paid by Mexican companies to resident INDIVIDUALS (art. 140 LISR), withheld by the company; final payment. Separate from the corporate tax credit mechanism.
figures.quote: una tasa adicional del 10% sobre los dividendos

figures.item: Gross-up factor (art. 140 LISR) used to compute the corporate ISR credit an individual can take on dividends in the annual return.
figures.quote: por el factor de 1.4286

figures.item: Withholding of 10% on dividends paid by Mexican companies to non-residents (art. 164 fr. IV LISR), subject to treaties.
figures.quote: aplicar la tasa del 10% sobre dichos dividendos

figures.item: IVA general rate (art. 1 LIVA) on sales of goods, independent services, rental and imports.
figures.quote: la tasa del 16%

figures.item: IVA zero rate (art. 2-A LIVA): e.g. most unprocessed food and medicines, menstrual products, exports (art. 29). Zero-rated sales keep the right to credit input IVA; exempt sales do not.
figures.quote: Actos o actividades gravadas a la tasa 0%

figures.item: Monthly IVA payment (definitive monthly payment) is due by day 17 of the following month (art. 5-D LIVA).
figures.quote: a más tardar el día 17 del mes siguiente al que corresponda el pago

figures.item: A persona moral that receives professional services (or rental, etc.) from an INDIVIDUAL withholds two-thirds of the IVA charged (RLIVA art. 3 fr. I), not the full 16%. Source: SAT-hosted RLIVA compilation (original text of 4 Dec 2006 carries this rule).
figures.quote: La retención se hará por las dos terceras partes del impuesto que se les traslade

figures.item: IVA withheld (art. 1-A LIVA) must be paid with the monthly payment or at the latest by day 17 of the following month.
figures.quote: a más tardar el día 17 del mes siguiente

figures.item: DIOT (declaración informativa de operaciones con terceros): under RMF 2026 rule 4.5.1, personas morales and personas físicas file it DURING the month following the month reported. The LIVA art. 32 text says day 17; the RMF rule gives the whole following month.
figures.quote: durante el mes inmediato posterior al que corresponda dicha información

figures.item: Región fronteriza norte (and sur) IVA stimulus: a credit equal to 50% of the IVA rate on qualifying sales/services delivered in the region, for registered taxpayers (Decree of 31 Dec 2018; southern decree 30 Dec 2020). Extended to 31 Dec 2026.
figures.quote: un crédito equivalente al 50% de la tasa del impuesto al valor agregado

figures.item: Región fronteriza norte: the decree recitals state the buyer bears an IVA burden of 8% on qualifying acts (the result of the 50% credit). Only for taxpayers in the padrón of beneficiaries.
figures.quote: únicamente se traslade al adquirente de los bienes o servicios una carga fiscal del 8%

figures.item: Región fronteriza norte ISR stimulus: credit of one third of ISR for taxpayers earning income exclusively in the region from business activity, if registered in the padrón. Extended to 31 Dec 2026.
figures.quote: un crédito fiscal equivalente a la tercera parte del impuesto sobre la renta

figures.item: The northern border decree (in force from 1 Jan 2019) and southern border decree (from 1 Jan 2021) were extended to 31 December 2026 by the Decree published in the DOF on 31 Dec 2025. Nothing proves they run in 2027.
figures.quote: estará vigente hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026

figures.item: CFDI may be cancelled WITHOUT the receiver's acceptance when the total is up to this amount (RMF 2026 rule 2.7.1.35 fr. I), among other listed cases (nómina, egresos, traslado, etc.).
figures.quote: montos totales de hasta $1,000.00

figures.item: CFDI cancellation deadline (art. 29-A CFF as amended by DOF 7 Nov 2025, in force 1 Jan 2026): at the latest in the month in which the annual ISR return for the year of issue must be filed, and with the receiver's acceptance. The SAT article page for 29-A shows a different, outdated wording.
figures.value: the month of the annual ISR return
figures.quote: se podrán cancelar a más tardar en el mes en el cual se deba presentar la declaración anual

figures.item: If the receiver does not answer a cancellation request, the SAT cancels the CFDI automatically after three business days (SAT Esquema de cancelación de CFDI 2026, rule 2.7.1.34 RMF).
figures.quote: una vez transcurrido el plazo de tres días hábiles

figures.item: RESICO individuals may cancel their global CFDI (factura global) at the latest on the last day of April of the year after issue (rule 3.13.29 RMF, as printed in the SAT 2026 cancellation scheme).
figures.quote: a más tardar el último día de abril del ejercicio fiscal

figures.item: Transfer pricing: companies with related-party operations with residents in MEXICO whose prior-year business income did not exceed this amount may skip keeping TP documentation (RMF 2026). Art. 76 fr. IX LISR has the same thresholds for the TP study; not applicable to operations with preferential-regime (REFIPRE) entities or hydrocarbon contractors. The RMF prints $13’000,000.00 with an apostrophe separator, so write MXN 13 million.
figures.quote: no hayan excedido de $13’000,000.00 (trece millones de pesos 00/100 M.N.), así como aquellas

figures.item: Transfer pricing: companies whose prior-year income from PROFESSIONAL SERVICES did not exceed this amount may skip keeping TP documentation for operations with Mexican related parties (RMF 2026). figures.quote: $3’000,000.00 (tres millones de pesos 00/100 M.N.), podrán dejar de obtener

figures.item: Art. 32-H fr. I CFF threshold, updated for 2026 (Anexo 5 RMF 2026, in force 1 Jan 2026): companies with prior-year taxable income at or above this amount file the ISSIF and are among those obliged to file the local and master related-party returns (art. 76-A LISR).

figures.item: Art. 32-A CFF threshold for 2026: companies with prior-year taxable income at or above this amount must have their financial statements audited for tax purposes (dictamen fiscal).
figures.quote: iguales o superiores a un monto equivalente a $2,013,710,870.00

figures.item: Country-by-country return (art. 76-A fr. III LISR) is filed at the latest by 31 December of the year following the fiscal year (SAT page). The revenue threshold for CbCR was NOT found on a readable page.
figures.quote: A más tardar el 31 de diciembre del año inmediato posterior

figures.item: Fine (art. 82 fr. I d) CFF, amount updated for 2026 by Anexo 5 RMF): not filing returns electronically when obliged, filing late, or answering requirements late. Range lower end; upper end MXN 41,590. Reduced amounts apply for spontaneous compliance (art. 75/78 CFF, not proved here).
Upper end of the art. 82 fr. I d) CFF fine range for 2026 (late or non-electronic returns).

figures.item: Monthly surcharge (recargos) rate on extended tax debts (prórroga) for 2026 (LIF 2026 art. 11). Late-payment surcharges under art. 21 CFF are derived from this rate; do NOT state a computed late-payment rate.

figures.item: Monthly surcharge for authorised payment in installments of up to 12 months (LIF 2026 art. 11).

figures.item: Monthly surcharge for installments of more than 12 and up to 24 months (LIF 2026 art. 11).
